description: Reduce Adam beta2 from 0.95 to 0.995 to slightly decrease dependence on historical momentum and may help lower val_bpb by slowing gradient decay.
Reduce weight decay to 0.01 to allow gradients to flow more freely, potentially improving fit if under-constrained.
Smaller Depth
Increase ASPECT_RATIO
Increase WARMUP_RATIO to 0.1 to stabilize early training and allow the optimizer to escape sharp local minima.
Set WARMUP_RATIO and WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.0 to maintain a constant learning rate for the entire training budget.
Set WARMUP_RATIO to 0.01 and WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.8 to implement a very short ramp-up and a long decay schedule.
Set WARMUP_RATIO and WARMDOWN_RATIO to 0.5 to create a symmetric training schedule.
Increase Adam beta1 from 0.8 to 0.9 to dampen initial gradient noise and stabilize early training, targeting lower val_bpb.
Increase UNEMBEDDING_LR from 0.004 to 0.04 to allow faster learning of the output layer and potentially faster recovery of calibration.
Reducer
Decrease ASPECT_RATIO
Set FINAL_LR_FRAC to 0.01 to introduce a conservative final learning rate for smoothing optimization.
Add Residual Skip Connection
Low-Learn Edge
Increase the warmup ratio to 0.2 to provide more stability during the early phases of training.
Remove bias correction from the AdamW optimizer groups to speed up early convergence.
Zahlen
Reduce the warmdown ratio from 0.5 to 0.3 to maintain a higher learning rate for a longer portion of the training budget.
Reduce weight decay from 0.2 to 0.01 to allow more gradient flow to smaller weights and improve validation fit.
Reduce DEPTH from 8 to 6 and raise ASPECT_RATIO from 64 to 85 so model_dim stays at 512 (6*85=510, rounded up to 512 with HEAD_DIM 128).
